training_data_provenance: B3DB quantitative logBB dataset (1,058 compounds, 512 scaffolds)

uncertainty_evaluation.verdict: The reproduced logBB of +0.0139 satisfies the mathematical threshold (>= 0.0). However, the margin above zero (+0.0139) is 44.6 times smaller than the model's test RMSE (0.6215) and 41.9 times smaller than the ensemble tree standard deviation (0.5828). Because approximately 65% of variance in experimental logBB values is unexplained by this model (R2 = 0.3538), this outcome represents a statistically borderline computational classification rather than confirmed in vivo brain penetration.

independent_validation_resource_status.recommended_experimental_assay: In vitro PAMPA-BBB permeability assay and MDCK-MDR1 bidirectional transport assay (efflux ratio determination).
